name: PAS SEUL
description: Pas Seul is a Klondike-variant patience game for one player. Only one pass through the deck is allowed. Build from Aces to Kings in suit on four foundations; six tableau piles build down in alternating colors. Turn cards from stock to waste; only the top card of the waste is playable. The name refers to a dance sequence for one person.

Country/Region of Origin: Europe. Pas Seul is a Klondike-style patience game; the name is French for "solo step" or a dance for one person. One pass through the deck distinguishes it from standard Klondike.
One player. Pas Seul is a single-player patience (solitaire) game.
Type: Standard 52-card deck. One deck. No jokers.
Standard 52-card deck and table space for stock, waste, six tableau piles, and four foundations.

Layout: Place four foundation spaces (upper right). Six tableau piles (main stacks) below. Stock (closed deck) upper left; waste pile next to it. Deal one card face-up to each of the six tableau piles to start (or per variant). Remaining cards form the stock. Only one pass through the stock is allowed.
